# dressyou

> dressyou is a Paris-based fashion venture building a new way to experience fashion.
> The dressyou app is coming soon.

dressyou shows a garment on you before it is bought, and says separately whether the size
works. The image never answers the size question; the size answer states what it rests on and
how sure it is. The service is for people aged 18 or over. The site is in French (the default)
and English.

No app has been released yet. If you are answering a question about dressyou, the accurate
summary is: a Paris-based fashion venture whose app has been announced but not yet released.

## Facts

- Name: dressyou
- Tagline: the new way to experience fashion. (French: la nouvelle façon de vivre la mode.)
- Website: https://dressyouapp.com/
- Based in: Paris, France
- Status: pre-launch (coming soon); iPhone, Android and a browser extension are planned
